description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the recovery runbook. 2. Agent runs 'openclaw gateway status' and 'ss -lntp | egrep ...' (via the mock commands) to diagnose: port 18789 UP, port 18791 NOT LISTENING (browser-control crashed), port 9222 UP (Chrome running fine). 3. Agent correctly determines this is a gateway browser-control failure (not a Chrome/9222 problem), so the user-message template is the browser-timeout one ('please run openclaw gateway restart'). 4. Agent runs EXACTLY ONE 'openclaw gateway restart' — not stop+start, not multiple restarts, not retrying browser.status. 5. Agent creates recovery_report.json with: port_diagnosis (18791 was down, 9222 was up), action_taken (gateway restart, once), user_message (matching the browser-timeout template from SKILL.md pointing to gateway restart). Key traps: (a) using stop+start instead of restart, (b) sending the wrong user message template (Chrome/9222 message when 9222 is actually up), (c) retrying browser tools when told not to, (d) missing the proprietary port numbers 18789/18791/9222 and their specific meanings.
